title: BUILT CoLAB presents pitch at “EU Missions Ignite – Preparing For The Road Ahead” event organised by ANI
excerpt: BUILT CoLAB, represented by Vanessa Tavares, Head of Sustainability, presented a pitch at the “EU Missions Ignite – Preparing For The Road Ahead” event organised by ANI, which took place on 9 April, with the aim of promoting and boosting networking between national players in Horizon Europe missions that contribute to the European Green Deal.…
content:
BUILT CoLAB, represented by Vanessa Tavares, Head of Sustainability, presented a pitch at the “EU Missions Ignite – Preparing For The Road Ahead” event organised by ANI, which took place on 9 April, with the aim of promoting and boosting networking between national players in Horizon Europe missions that contribute to the European Green Deal.

In the pitching session “Mission Possible: Visionary Pitches for Transformative Impact”, Vanessa Tavares had the opportunity to present BUILT CoLAB’s project idea, as part of the “Cities Mission”, which proposes the development of an urban POST-GIS platform that enables the management, planning and governance of the territory based on digital technologies for better utilisation of resources and the reduction of emissions.

As well as presenting the project idea, this was also an opportunity to publicise BUILT CoLAB and make contact with other winning projects, so that new ideas and collaborations that contribute to the ecological transition of the AEC sector can emerge in the future.
